start: No rest running; the phone's Bluetooth turned off or the phone far away

user_sees: After two checks: a slashed phone icon
'Keep your phone near you with Bluetooth on.'
must_not: The old set shown as if the phone were there

steps.action: Bring the phone back with Bluetooth on
user_sees: The screen before (between sets or 'Start a workout on your phone')
must_not: 'Phone not connected' staying after the link is back

start: A rest is running; the phone is left in a locker

user_sees: The countdown keeps running and the watch buzzes at the end
must_not: 'Phone not connected' hiding the countdown or the buzz

user_sees: 'Phone not connected' after the rest-is-over screen
must_not: The watch claiming the set was saved

start: The link drops for one moment only

must_not: A flash of 'Phone not connected' after one empty check

start: 'Phone not connected' showing during an open workout

user_sees: The current set from the phone within a few seconds
must_not: The set from before the drop
